### Overview of Changes
- Created **[LevelMeters.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/LevelMeters.h)**:
  - Declares the **[LevelMeters](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/LevelMeters.h#L17)** subclass of `juce::Component` and `juce::Timer`.
  - Defines the public **[setTelemetrySources](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/LevelMeters.h#L24)** binding API for connecting external lock-free telemetry handles (`std::atomic<float>`).
  - Configures standard ballistics parameters (fast attack, exponential decay for RMS, peak-hold frames, and envelope decay for peak and saturation reduction values).
- Created **[LevelMeters.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/LevelMeters.cpp)**:
  - Implements the 60 Hz timer callback to safely poll the atomic handles without blocking or invoking the audio thread.
  - Implements a vertical layout rendering matching the ShredBoost color theme (gradients from cyan to magenta for inputs and outputs, and a downward-growing amber/orange vertical gain-reduction bar for drive saturation).
  - Renders visual tick marks, channel labels, and a numerical readout for the saturation peak reduction.
- Temporarily verified compilation and unit test logic (checking correct defaults, binding, and decay decay-hold behavior) and reverted the temporary changes to `CMakeLists.txt` to align strictly with Phase G guidelines.
